**STR** 12 (+1) | **DEX** 15 (+2) | **CON** 11 (+0) | **INT** 1 (-5) | **WIS** 5 (-3) | **CHA** 1 (-5)
**Saving Throws:** [Saving Throw: DEX](../proficiencies/saving-throw-dex.md) +4
